profile_text.body:
Eightfold is a Mountain View, California company that describes itself as an agentic talent intelligence platform aimed at HR leaders. Its site says the platform covers recruiting, screening, hiring, and talent management, and that some customers have reduced time-to-fill by 33% while others have filled roles in as little as 1.3 days. The company positions its system as decision-support rather than decision-making, stating that its AI agents support interviews and evaluate candidates but that recruiters retain final authority.

The core product, tracked under the HR and Talent AI category, is the Eightfold AI platform, which includes a feature called AI Interviewer designed for high-volume hiring scenarios where a single role may attract 500 or more applicants. The site also describes a certification the company calls the world's first AI management standard, under which its AI is said to be built, governed, and monitored against an independent, audited framework, with bias testing of AI Interviewer conducted by outside auditors whose results the company says are publicly available.

The held facts note 181 legal cases with California exposure, which is consistent with Eightfold's headquarters in Mountain View and the volume of employment-related litigation that can accompany a platform used for high-stakes employment decisions. No MCP server registrations or SEC filings are recorded for the company in the site's data.
